scope: Final matched evaluation of the completed r2 epoch-1 native H3 identity-topology LoRA
summary: The final r2 checkpoint retains a narrow native topology improvement and raises several task proxies, but it does not increase fully passing topology frames and materially regresses object lock, frozen appearance identity, and matched pixel motion; the hard RSI contract rejects it.
evidence: The final rank-16 checkpoint is 65,626,168 bytes with SHA-256 5511399cbe84c2bf1017677c894d3c546cb5cac7699616bd82b268faf2ef8bb3.

The exact candidate video SHA-256 is 831ed2defe40d5410827e46e0ba6c7f9bee4c03afaf40fdc4f882de4a6408b6c; its 124-frame topology evidence SHA-256 is bdb96a5310ec212ca216e6b297dca294f862df47bba3d5708f56a8c2461d6c08.

Baseline topology failures are left shoulder 100, stable proportions 100, and head-to-torso chain 82. The final candidate retains only the 100 left-shoulder failures, but full-frame topology remains 24/124 for both baseline and candidate.
The matched task evaluator changes motion 0.4819401811 to 0.5646415103, EPL 0.4495309505 to 0.5020783871, robot-identity proxy 0.7124955947 to 0.7210642124, and temporal 0.9459162812 to 0.9529279377.
Object lock collapses from 1.0 to 0.0005199057. After adding object lock to the conservative action contract, normalized action adherence is 0.0011565515.

Frozen DINOv2 worst-frame identity falls from 0.8833816648 to 0.7872591913 and matched pixel-motion adherence is 0.8949289860. Scene and temporal non-regression pass, while identity gain, identity floor, topology, motion, and action gates fail.
The final evaluator ran on physical A800 GPU 1, records all input hashes, and hashes the pinned local DINOv2 model files at revision ed25f3a31f01632728cabb09d1542f84ab7b0056.
lessons: A curriculum can remove specific head/torso and proportion failure categories without improving the hard conjunction when a single shoulder-origin defect remains widespread.
Task motion and identity proxies can improve while object retention collapses; object lock must participate in the action non-regression gate rather than being reported only as a diagnostic.
The second epoch amplifies appearance and motion regression relative to r2 epoch 0, so the RSI loop correctly retains r2 epoch 0 only as the least-regressing research checkpoint and promotes neither.
limitations: This is one 124-frame held-out identity, scene, and action using third-party NF4 MiniMax-H3 weights, not the official BF16 base.
Topology labels are digest-bound 2-D semantic review, not 3-D kinematics, physical contact, or real-robot evidence.
No candidate passes the release contract, so neither the checkpoint nor its demo is described as a publishable improved model.
next_actions: Build a v3 training split with camera-matched raised-arm positives, explicit shoulder-origin crops, and neck/head-emergence hard negatives.
Freeze at least three held-out identities, scenes, actions, and object-lock masks before another training round.
Repeat the bounded search on an official BF16 H3 base only after license and compute review.
